chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim from Aban ibn Taghlib who said:

I went out with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) in what is between Mecca and Medina, so he would say: 'As for you, you are youths, you delay; and as for me, I am an old man, I hasten.' So he would pray the night prayer at the beginning of the night.
ai.seo_question: Why did the Imam pray the night prayer early?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practical wisdom of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in tailoring spiritual practices to individual physical capacities, contrasting the endurance of youth with the need for the elderly to act before fatigue sets in. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on *muru'ah* (dignity) and consistency in voluntary worship, illustrating how the Imams modeled adaptability in *Salat al-Layl* without compromising its spiritual essence. The narration serves as a timeless guideline for balancing zeal with sustainability in devotional life.
